body:
Confirmed the same behaviour with the same errors on 4.6.2.stable when following the repro steps, but if the project is just opened and closed immediately there are no leak messages.

```
WARNING: 19 RIDs of type "CanvasItem" were leaked.
     at: _free_rids (servers/rendering/renderer_canvas_cull.cpp:2692)
ERROR: 2 RID allocations of type 'N10RendererRD14TextureStorage7TextureE' were leaked at exit.
WARNING: 4 RIDs of type "Texture" were leaked.
     at: finalize (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:7505)
ERROR: 102 RID allocations of type 'PN18TextServerAdvanced22ShapedTextDataAdvancedE' were leaked at exit.
ERROR: 1 RID allocations of type 'PN18TextServerAdvanced12FontAdvancedE' were leaked at exit.
WARNING: ObjectDB instances leaked at exit (run with --verbose for details).
     at: cleanup (core/object/object.cpp:2641)
```

Also confirmed on 4.7 latest (`v4.7.beta.custom_build.070dc9897`) with slightly different quantities:
```
WARNING: 18 RIDs of type "CanvasItem" were leaked.
   at: _free_rids (servers/rendering/renderer_canvas_cull.cpp:2735)
ERROR: 2 RID allocations of type 'N10RendererRD14TextureStorage7TextureE' were leaked at exit.
WARNING: 4 RIDs of type "Texture" were leaked.
   at: finalize (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:8894)
 - RID:206879984716961
 - RID:298315543483533
 - RID:206875689749664
 - RID:298311248516236
ERROR: 100 RID allocations of type 'PN18TextServerAdvanced22ShapedTextDataAdvancedE' were leaked at exit.
ERROR: 1 RID allocations of type 'PN18TextServerAdvanced12FontAdvancedE' were leaked at exit.
WARNING: 128 ObjectDB instances were leaked at exit (run with `--verbose` for details).
   at: cleanup (core/object/object.cpp:2535)
```

Verbose output: [leak-output.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28669268/leak-output.txt)

System Info:
```
Godot v4.7.beta (070dc9897) - Pop!_OS 24.04 LTS on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (nvidia; 580.159.03) - AMD Ryzen 7 3700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.26 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)
```

Likely cause is there are page size number (20 in my case) slots pre-created when an array or dictionary is created. However some buttons are not immediately parented and rely on a reparent step in later code. But if the slot isn't visible it skips reparenting the buttons and they then leak. The leak size decreases as number of entries increases until it reaches page size then there is no leak. Actively working on fix
